subject: Shiny server cannot find custom location for R installation

messages.author: 3e6f1b670997f3e4
messages.subject: Shiny server cannot find custom location for R installation
parts: Hello, I have installed Shiny server on a VM at work running Red Hat OS (version 6).  One issue I have run across is that Shiny server is not finding the installation of R, which is in a custom location (for the sake of example: /path/to/R/installation/bin/R).  I've been able to use RStudio server on this VM without a problem since I can define a custom path to R in the RStudio server configuration files.  Is there a similar configuration option for the Shiny server configuration?  I checked the configuration reference here and did not see an option for a custom path to R.  If there isn't a configuration option, how do I enable Shiny server to see the custom installation location of R?

messages.author: 3e6f1b670997f3e4
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server cannot find custom location for R installation
parts: As a follow up to my question, I was able to get it working by making a symbolic link to the custom R installation, so that /usr/bin/R maps to /path/to/R/installation/bin/R .  However it would be nice to have a configuration option for this like how RStudio server implements this option.  Has anyone else found a way to specify this within a shiny configuration setting?

messages.subject: Re: Shiny server cannot find custom location for R installation
parts:
We could certainly make this more robust in the future by supporting an explicit configuration option.

In the meantime, can you try setting an environment variable named "R" to point to the path you want to use -- perhaps in the init.d or upstart script? I think that should do the trick.

I've got the same setup: I've been testing my app on Glimmer, and am trying to now deploy it on a Shiny server on a VM at work running Red Hat OS.  When I check "which R" on my work VM, it points to /usr/bin/R, where I've got R 3.0.1 running.  Unfortunately, I'm noticing my CSV data isn't reading in the same way as it is on Glimmer (which looks like it's running R 2.15.3).  So, I'm trying to add a separate install of R 2.15.3 on my work VM to see if the R version discrepancy is what's causing the problem.

Jeff, or anyone else: do you know where I would set the R environment variable to point to my install of R 2.15.3?  Could I do that in my Shiny server configuration file?  Or is there a way to override the default path to R 3.0.1 on my work VM to point to R 2.15.3 instead?

server {
        listen 80;
        location / {
                site_dir /var/www/shiny;
                log_dir /var/log/shiny;
                directory_index off;

}
}

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server cannot find custom location for R installation
parts:
Hi Allison,

If you set an environment variable named "R" to the path of the R binary you wish Shiny Server to run before starting the server (for instance, in /etc/init.d/shiny-server, or /etc/init/shiny-server.conf) Shiny Server should respect that and run the appropriate version of R.

We have this feature on our TODO list for inclusion in the config file, however, so users could use different versions of R for different locations or applications. It may take us a while to get to that feature, however.

Jeff
